title: Writer-customer troubleshooting questions
summary: This topic mainly captures back-and-forth troubleshooting questions between service writers and customers, with most examples lacking enough outcome detail to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe helpful guidance or product clarification, such as recommending navigation use or discussing desired features like a sunroof.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe troubleshooting around unresolved problems, including recurring issues and repeated CarPlay reset or software-check questions.

mixed.summary: The mixed sample is too limited to identify a clear theme beyond a customer asking about obtaining an item online.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly procedural exchanges about vehicle access, settings, account setup, updates, or clarifying what the customer meant, without clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined because they record intermediate troubleshooting questions rather than outcomes.
The topic is broad and procedural, so concrete issue patterns are only weakly supported by the provided examples.
The mixed sentiment evidence is limited to a single fragment, so no broader mixed theme can be established.
